tx.next_deadline_note: 2026-27 Drawn Hunts: Aug 1 (alligator, private-land dove); Aug 15 (archery deer, archery mule deer, pronghorn, private-land pronghorn, javelina); other categories on the 1st and 15th of each month Aug 1 - Nov 1. E-Postcard and USFS permits need the Annual Public Hunting Permit (on sale Aug 15).
tx.otc: Texas has no statewide big-game lottery: deer (white-tailed and mule deer) are hunted on a hunting license with over-the-counter tags, almost entirely on private land. Pronghorn hunting is mainly by landowner-issued permits, and elk are not a native game animal (no draw). The Drawn Hunts program only covers specific public tracts (WMAs, state parks, refuges) and leased private lands.

deer.system_summary: Deer tags come with the hunting license over the counter. TPWD's Drawn Hunts program offers area-specific deer hunts on WMAs, state parks, refuges and leased private land (about 9,800 permits across 60+ categories in 2026-27); these are quota hunts, not unit draws.
